explication: God’s Eye View is a browser-based live intelligence globe. A user explores or searches the globe, enables data layers, and inspects or tracks live and mapped activity; optional voice and scene-authoring tools add analysis and presentation workflows. The graph emphasizes those product stages and the map, data, and interaction layers. README claims preserve major capabilities, while sampled source supports only selected internal relationships; unsampled subsystem wiring is intentionally limited.
